minor_issues.issue: 图 3 中间体 19 的化学结构描述为'α,β-不饱和酯'，与原文 Figure 3 不一致
minor_issues.source_locator: PDF 第 12 页 Figure 3 / 第 3 页正文 Materials and methods
minor_issues.correction: 18 经 Swern 氧化生成醛后与乙烯基 Grignard (CH2=CH-MgBr) 加成，所得 19 应为 PhCH(NHBoc)CH(OH)CH=CH2，即 N-Boc-高烯丙醇 / Homoallylic alcohol（仲醇带末端乙烯基），并非 α,β-不饱和酯。建议改为'Swern 氧化再经乙烯基溴化镁处理得 N-Boc-α-乙烯基-β-氨基醇 19, 52%'。

minor_issues.issue: 14 关环反应条件缩写'p-TsOH·HOTf'与原文 Figure 3 不符
minor_issues.source_locator: PDF 第 12 页 Figure 3 中 19 → 20 反应条件标注
minor_issues.correction: 原文标注为 'pyr·HOTs / toluene, 85 °C'，即吡啶鎓对甲苯磺酸盐 (PPTS)，不是 p-TsOH·HOTf 的混合酸。建议改为'2,2-二甲氧基丙烷 / PPTS / 甲苯，85°C'。

minor_issues.issue: 'N-脱苯甲酰紫杉醇 (6) 总产率 28%' 未注明起始原料，原文 '28% from 1' 系印刷或 OCR 错误
minor_issues.source_locator: PDF 第 3 页正文（'overall yield 28% from 1'）
minor_issues.correction: 按 Figure 2 给出的各步收率 (70% × 80% × 82% × 60% ≈ 27.6%) 反推，28% 应为自起始原料 10-脱乙酰巴卡丁 III (11) 的整体收率，而非化合物 1 ((S)-苯丙氨酸) 或化合物 13。建议改为'自 10-脱乙酰巴卡丁 III (11) 整体 28%'。

verified_claims.claim: TAX10 对 N-脱苯甲酰-2′-脱氧紫杉醇 (5) 为变量底物（苯甲酰 CoA 1 mM 饱和）时 Km = 346 ± 70 µM，Vmax = 688 ± 59 nmol/min，V/Km ≈ 1.99
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 6 页 Results 第 1 段
verified_claims.evidence: 'With N-debenzoyl-2′-deoxytaxol (5) as variable co-substrate (benzoyl CoA at 1 mM), a Km value of 346 ± 70 µM and Vmax of 688 ± 59 nmol/min (V/Km = 1.99) were determined (Fig. 4).'

verified_claims.claim: TAX10 对 N-脱苯甲酰紫杉醇 (6) 为变量底物时 Km = 78 ± 11 µM，Vmax = 349 ± 15 nmol/min，V/Km ≈ 4.47
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 6 页 Results 第 1 段
verified_claims.evidence: 'In the case of N-debenzoyltaxol (6) as the variable co-substrate (benzoyl CoA again at 1 mM), a Km value of 78 ± 11 µM and Vmax of 349 ± 15 nmol/min (V/Km = 4.47) were determined (Fig. 4).'

verified_claims.claim: TAX10 对 N-脱苯甲酰紫杉醇 (6) 较对 N-脱苯甲酰-2′-脱氧紫杉醇 (5) 的催化效率偏好约为两倍，主要体现为 Km 差异
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 6 页 Results 与第 7 页 Discussion
verified_claims.evidence: 'The difference in kinetic efficiencies for benzoyl transfer between N-debenzoyltaxol (6) and N-debenzoyl-2′-deoxytaxol (5), while small (about two-fold, reflected primarily in difference in Km values), appears significant...' '...a two-fold difference in kinetic efficiency based on V/Km...'

verified_claims.claim: tigloyl-CoA 不产生 cephalomannine (8)，但产生保留时间接近但不一致的未知化合物，速率约苯甲酰化反应的 15%；hexanoyl-CoA 类似，产生未知副产物速率约 5%
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 6 页 Results 'Selectivity for the CoA ester co-substrate'
verified_claims.evidence: '...did not detectably N-transfer from tigloyl-CoA to N-debenzoyltaxol to produce cephalomannine (taxol B, 8). An unknown compound was produced, at rates roughly 15% of the corresponding benzamidation reaction...' '...did not detectably N-transfer from hexanoyl-CoA to N-debenzoyltaxol to form taxol C (9). Again, in this case, an unknown compound was produced, at rates roughly 5% of the benzamidation reaction...'

verified_claims.claim: TAX10 在 butanoyl-CoA / N-脱苯甲酰紫杉醇组合下无活性，且既不与乙酰辅酶 A 反应；超表达理论上可使紫杉醇产量提升近三倍
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 7 页 Results 与 Discussion 末段
verified_claims.evidence: 'the N-transferase showed no detectable activity in the presence of N-debenzoyltaxol (6) and butanoyl-CoA to effect the formation of taxcultine (taxol D, 10), nor were any products formed via transfer from acetyl-CoA to N-debenzoyltaxol...' 'Overexpression of the TAX10 N-benzoyl transferase in culture might be expected to increase the biosynthesis of Taxol at the expense of taxols B, C and D, with the potential for improving production yield nearly three-fold...'

verified_claims.claim: 酶制备为 75% 纯度、3.5 mg/mL TAX10 储液；动力学线性区间为 10 µM 蛋白、10 min；三组独立制剂、SE < ±12%
